a2.predicate: a t1 wire whose lower-cased, whitespace-collapsed span equals that of any wire of synth_short_r2

about: ModernBERT-next campaign, step 1: the frozen sources, grouping rules, reservation, support thresholds, arms and decision constants (reports/modernbert-next-plan-2026-11-08_codex.md). Paths of sources are relative to training/sketch; cache paths relative to ~/.cache/diagram-vss-modernbert.

arms.B: repaired output/annotation contract on C100 source membership
arms.R: B plus the eight restored folders
arms.S: R plus non-reserved r2 whole messages

c100.about: C100 training membership = the 23 label folders: make_data.py DIRS (9 older) + build_arm_data.sh FIRST (12) + SAMPLE_DIRS (2, trained with --all) + nl_p1/nl_p2 opus rows (nl_share.py SHARE=100) minus the rows whose normalised text equals a test text (nl_dropped_ids). The oracle is the C100 cut_train.jsonl (whole messages) whose hash complete.json records.

grouping.group_key: smallest message id of the group (string order)
grouping.normalisation: lower case + whitespace runs collapsed to one space

m2n.about: arm M2n (build_arm_data.sh M2n, WITH_M2S=1): C100's list + the eight restored folders; its cut_train ids must equal R

families.natural-language: nl_a calibration (reported, not one of the three required)
